title: EIAV — equine infectious anaemia virus Coverage Audit
standfirst: EIAV is the lentivirus of horses and the smallest module in this family — one virus, little vocabulary, and the clearest example in the set of a tiny accessory gene that is nonetheless essential. Four features carry profiles; rev is declared and called by the splice caller, and tat is recognised but not declared.

sections.title: What the module calls
sections.lede: Four profiled features, and an 11-of-11 accessory gene smaller than most peptides.

blocks.html: S2 is 59–83 aa and is called on every exemplar. It was marked essential on evidence: 30 of 30 held-out genomes, and out of frame with env in 29 of 29 — a separate gene, not a cleavage product of the envelope it sits inside.

sections.title: Where it does not call, and why

blocks.html: tat is spliced in EIAV and is not declared; the string is recognised and recorded, which is why the collapse report shows it bound to a target the module JSON does not carry. gag, pol and env are each called on 10 of 11 exemplars; the one miss is a single short record, not a profile failure.

87.0% of the 300 deposited features from this module's taxa are bound by a naming rule. The remainder are recorded in UNASSIGNED and DISCARDED: the first is vocabulary no rule reached, the second is records the source itself calls partial or truncated, which the project discards rather than trains on.

sections.title: Vocabulary saturation
sections.lede: How fast each vocabulary stops growing as genomes are added.

blocks.html: The deposited vocabulary keeps growing; the module's does not. At the depth both reach, 23.7 distinct source strings correspond to 5.0 controlled annotations, a 4.7-fold collapse. The module reaches 95% of its final vocabulary after 12 proteins against the source's 62.

Coverage is measured by annotating de-replicated exemplars through the real GTO pipeline — annotate_by_viral_pssm-GTO.pl, then the transcript-edit and splice passes, then viral_genome_quality.pl — not by a reimplementation. Spliced features are included, which the flat feature-table path cannot represent. Rates are per exemplar, and exemplars are clustered at 95% nucleotide identity, so one row is one distinct sequence rather than one deposit.

source_note: Measured 27 October 2026 from the shipped module: the EIAV block of Viral_PSSM.json, its profiles and collections, and the 27 October coverage re-annotation over 11 exemplars de-replicated from 265 genomes. Vocabulary figures come from collections/synonyms.tsv, written by the module's own builder from the naming rules, and count deposited features rather than unique sequences.
